senses.gloss:
भामः [भाम्-घञ्]
1 Brightness,
lustre, splendour.
--2 The sun
--3
Passion, wrath, anger.
--4 A sister's
husband.
--मा
1 A passionate
woman.
--2 N. of one of the wives of
Kṛṣṇa, usually called सत्यभामा.
--Comp.
--नी m. the Supreme being.

भामिन् a.
1 Passionate, angry.
--2
Shining.
--3 Handsome, beautiful.

1 A beautiful young
woman; (कामिनी); R. 8. 28.
--2 A
passionate woman (often used like चंडी
as a term of endearment); उपचीयत
एव कापि शोभा परितो भामिनि ते मुखस्य
नित्यं Bv. 2. 1.
--Comp.
--विलासः N.
of a poem by Jagannātha Paṇḍita.
